app.name: SG Map Explorer
app.title: SG Map Explorer | UwU Apps
app.description: A live 3D map of Singapore: MRT, buses, carparks, traffic, weather and air quality, layer by layer.
language.modal.title: Choose a language
map.label: Map of Singapore
map.no-webgl: This browser can't draw the 3D map: it needs WebGL, which is off or missing here. Try another browser, or turn on hardware acceleration.
controls.label: Map controls
compass.none: No compass reading here. On a phone, move it in a figure of eight; on a computer, the map stays north up.
compass.denied: The map can't read the compass without your OK. Allow motion and orientation for this site to turn it.
locate.denied: Location is off for this site, so the map can't show where you are.
locate.failed: Couldn't find where you are just now.
locate.outside: You're outside Singapore, so the map stays on the island.
pitch.zoom: Zoom in closer to see the buildings stand up.
layers.title: Map layers
layers.intro: Turn on what you want to see. Live layers update while the map is open.
layers.sources: Data: LTA DataMall, NEA and PUB through data.gov.sg, OneMap, URA, OpenFreeMap and OpenStreetMap contributors.
layer.failed: Couldn't load this layer. Try again in a minute.
layer.offline: You're offline. Showing the last copy, if there is one.
layer.zoom-in: Zoom in to see bicycle parking here.

save.title: Singapore's map, offline
save.intro: Keep Singapore's map on this device, so the streets, the buildings and the MRT still show with no connection.
save.estimate: {count} map tiles from OpenFreeMap, about {size}. Best on Wi-Fi.
save.update-cancelled: Update cancelled. The map saved before is still there.
save.capped: The map came near {size}, OpenFreeMap's limit for one download, so it stopped there: the closest-in view of some places isn't saved.
save.some-failed: {failed} of its {total} parts couldn't be saved. Try again to fill them in.
save.done: Saved. The map now works with no connection.
save.removed: Removed. The map keeps what you look at, as before.
save.newer: OpenFreeMap has a newer map out. Update to get it; the one saved still works offline meanwhile.
save.no-worker: Saving the map needs the app's offline support, which isn't on yet. Reload the app and try again.
save.offline: Saving the map needs a connection.
save.too-many: That's {count} tiles, more than the {max} OpenFreeMap allows in one download.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tour-note: The map shows you around the first time you open it. Pick it to see the tour again.
settings.gestures-note: Drag two fingers up or down to tilt the map, twist them to turn it, and pinch to zoom.
basemap.openfreemap.name: OpenFreeMap
basemap.openfreemap.note: Detailed streets and 3D buildings. Saves for offline.

basemap.osm.name: OpenStreetMap

theme.title: Theme
tour.map.label: The map
tour.map.map: Singapore, live. Drag two fingers up or down to tilt it and see the buildings in 3D. Tap a marker for what it is.
tour.map.layers: Every layer is in here: getting around, roads, weather, air quality and OneMap's themes.
tour.map.quick: Quick switches for MRT, bus stops, the forecast, carparks, taxis and traffic cameras.
tour.map.compass: Turn the map with your phone, so it faces the way you do.
tour.map.pitch: Tilt the map to 3D and back.
tour.map.save: Save Singapore's map on this device, for when there's no signal.
tour.map.settings: Settings has the base map and this tour again. Theme and language are just above.
